audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart reads flat 'Skill 5/10' on six of seven rows while the content layer and the packet chart both say Zed owns Levels 1 through First item and Azir owns 2+ items. The page renders two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: Azir's early lane is soldier-dependent: Arise! costs 40 energy at rank 1 and Conquering Sands is a 14s cooldown at rank 1 costing 70 mana, so he cannot contest a 6s Q from Zed. Late, Emperor's Divide is terrain that blocks dash paths and his soldier range outreaches every Zed tool.
audit.corrected: Sides set to Zed on rows 0-5 and Azir on row 6, with each why rewritten to match the verdict.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: level 3 (E online, full W-E-Q string), level 6 Death Mark at 120s, first item, and Azir's full-build inversion. Azir's own spike is late because Conquering Sands only reaches a 6s cooldown at rank 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the two decisive interactions: Azir's Shifting Sands is a shielded dash on a 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s cooldown that both escapes your string and absorbs part of it, and Emperor's Divide is terrain — it knocks you back and walls the path your W shadow and Death Mark dash need.
audit.why: Zed's W (20/19/18/17/16s) and R are both dashes; Azir's R flag is terrain, which denies dash paths. Azir's E carries a shield flag, which changes the all-in maths against burst.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now names 22s/16s on Shifting Sands and 20s on Living Shadow; the Don'ts bullet now states the Emperor's Divide knock-back during the 3-second mark.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no number at all.
audit.why: It is the field that must hold real cooldowns; the kit gives 22/20.5/19/17.5/16 on Shifting Sands, 20/19/18/17/16 on Living Shadow and 120/110/100 on Death Mark.
